recipe.title: Beef dan dan
recipe.notes: This is a My Food Bag recipe (Amy worked out the spice mix proportions).
recipe.prep: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.

method.s: Fry mushrooms, mince and dry spices for about five minutes, breaking up mince as it cooks.
Thoroughly combine the garlic, peanut butter, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar and water.
When beef is cooked, remove from heat and stir through sauce. Season to taste with more soy sauce.
Serve with some greens and topped with radish or daikon.
